# datahub_form (Resource)

**DataHub ✅ | DataHub Cloud ✅**

Creates and manages a DataHub **form** -- a metadata-collection questionnaire (`COMPLETION`) or compliance check (`VERIFICATION`) whose prompts ask asset owners to fill in structured property values. The optional `dynamic_assignment` block assigns the form automatically to every entity matching a search filter.

The calling principal needs the **Manage Metadata Forms** (`MANAGE_FORMS`) platform privilege.

## Full-state ownership

This resource owns the complete form definition: the prompts list, the actors lists and the dynamic assignment filter are fully replaced on every apply, so prompts or actor assignments added outside Terraform (UI, SDK) are removed on the next apply. Omitting `dynamic_assignment` removes any dynamic assignment on the form.

## Assignment is asynchronous and additive

DataHub assigns the form to matching entities via a background hook after the filter is written. Narrowing or removing the filter stops *future* assignment but does not retract the form from entities that already carry it; deleting the form does (asynchronously).

## Delete semantics

Destroy is a hard delete. DataHub asynchronously removes references to the form from assigned entities, including completion and verification records. Structured property values collected through the form's prompts are ordinary metadata on the target entities and survive the form's deletion.

## URN

The URN is `urn:li:form:<form_id>` (deterministic, matching the DataHub Python SDK). If `form_id` is omitted it is derived from `name`. ImportState accepts either the full URN or a bare `form_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A form asks asset owners to fill in structured property values, either to
# collect metadata (COMPLETION) or to attest compliance (VERIFICATION).
# Prompts reference structured properties by URN; use the resource reference
# so Terraform creates the property first.
resource "datahub_structured_property" "data_classification" {
  property_id  = "tf-example-form-classification"
  value_type   = "string"
  entity_types = ["dataset"]

  display_name = "TF Example - Form Classification"
  description  = "Data sensitivity classification collected via a form."
  allowed_values = [
    { string_value = "Public" },
    { string_value = "Internal" },
    { string_value = "Confidential" },
  ]
}

resource "datahub_form" "pii_verification" {
  form_id     = "tf-example-pii-verification"
  name        = "TF Example - PII Verification"
  description = "Quarterly attestation that datasets carry a classification."
  type        = "VERIFICATION"

  prompts = [{
    # Prompt ids must be globally unique across all forms; completion records
    # are keyed by them, so changing an id resets collected responses.
    id                      = "tf-example-pii-verification-classification"
    title                   = "Classify this dataset"
    description             = "Pick the sensitivity level that applies."
    type                    = "STRUCTURED_PROPERTY"
    structured_property_urn = datahub_structured_property.data_classification.urn
    required                = true
  }]

  # Who fills the form in. Omit the block to assign it to the owners of each
  # matched asset (the default).
  actors = {
    owners = true
    groups = ["urn:li:corpGroup:governance-team"]
  }

  # Assign the form automatically to every Snowflake dataset. Assignment runs
  # asynchronously server-side; removing or narrowing the filter stops future
  # assignment but does not retract the form from entities already assigned.
  dynamic_assignment = {
    or_filters = [{
      and = [
        {
          field  = "_entityType"
          values = ["DATASET"]
        },
        {
          field  = "platform.keyword"
          values = ["urn:li:dataPlatform:snowflake"]
        },
      ]
    }]
  }
}

output "form_urn" {
  description = "URN of the form (urn:li:form:<form_id>)."
  value       = datahub_form.pii_verification.urn
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-friendly name shown in the DataHub UI.

### Optional

- `actors` (Attributes) Who is asked to complete the form. Omitted, DataHub assigns the form to the owners of each matched asset (`owners = true`). This resource owns the complete `users` and `groups` lists. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actors))
- `description` (String) Description of what the form collects and why.
- `dynamic_assignment` (Attributes) Assigns the form automatically to every entity matching a search filter, instead of assigning entities one by one. Omitting the block removes any dynamic assignment from the form. Assignment runs asynchronously server-side; removing or narrowing the filter does not retract the form from entities already assigned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic_assignment))
- `form_id` (String) Unique id (URN suffix). If omitted, derived from `name` as `<sanitized-name>-<hash>`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `prompts` (Attributes List) Questions presented to the assigned actors. This resource owns the complete list; prompts added outside Terraform are removed on the next apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prompts))
- `type` (String) Form type: `COMPLETION` (collect metadata) or `VERIFICATION` (attest that an asset complies). Defaults to `COMPLETION`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource id; equal to `form_id`.
- `urn` (String) Full DataHub URN (`urn:li:form:<form_id>`).

<a id="nestedatt--actors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actors`

Optional:

- `groups` (List of String) Specific group URNs assigned the form (e.g. `["urn:li:corpGroup:governance"]`).
- `owners` (Boolean) Assign the form to the owners of the assets it is applied to. Defaults to `true`.
- `users` (List of String) Specific user URNs assigned the form (e.g. `["urn:li:corpuser:jdoe"]`).


<a id="nestedatt--dynamic_assignment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic_assignment`

Required:

- `or_filters` (Attributes List) Disjunction (OR) of filter groups; each group is a conjunction (AND) of facet predicates. An entity matches when it satisfies any group. Commonly filtered fields: `_entityType`, `platform.keyword`, `domains.keyword`, `container.keyword`, `typeNames.keyword` (sub-types), `owners.keyword`, `tags.keyword`, `glossaryTerms.keyword`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic_assignment--or_filters))

<a id="nestedatt--dynamic_assignment--or_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic_assignment.or_filters`

Required:

- `and` (Attributes List) Conjunction (AND) of facet predicates; all must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic_assignment--or_filters--and))

<a id="nestedatt--dynamic_assignment--or_filters--and"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic_assignment.or_filters.and`

Required:

- `field` (String) Search field to filter on (e.g. `platform.keyword`, `domains.keyword`).
- `values` (List of String) Values to match (e.g. `["urn:li:dataPlatform:snowflake"]`).

Optional:

- `condition` (String) Match operator. Defaults to `EQUAL`.
- `negated` (Boolean) Invert the predicate (NOT). Defaults to `false`.




<a id="nestedatt--prompts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prompts`

Required:

- `id` (String) Prompt id, **globally unique across all forms**. Required here (the server would otherwise mint a random UUID, which breaks deterministic state). Prompt completion records are keyed by this id, so changing it resets responses.
- `structured_property_urn` (String) URN of the structured property the prompt collects (e.g. `datahub_structured_property.x.urn`). The property must exist when the form is assigned; reference the resource rather than a raw URN so Terraform orders creation.
- `title` (String) Question shown to the user.
- `type` (String) Prompt type: `STRUCTURED_PROPERTY` (apply a structured property to the entity) or `FIELDS_STRUCTURED_PROPERTY` (apply one to each schema field).

Optional:

- `description` (String) Optional help text for the prompt.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the prompt must be answered for the form to complete. Defaults to `false`. Field-level prompts (`FIELDS_STRUCTURED_PROPERTY`) cannot be required.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full form URN.
terraform import datahub_form.pii_verification urn:li:form:tf-example-pii-verification

# The bare form_id (URN suffix) is also accepted.
terraform import datahub_form.pii_verification tf-example-pii-verification
```
